name: What is the role of structured data in AI SEO?

mainEntity.name: What is the role of structured data in AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structured data plays a critical role in AI SEO by explicitly communicating the meaning and relationships of your website's content to search engines. It uses a standardized format, like Schema.org, to tag entities such as products, services, events, or local business information. This markup helps AI algorithms categorize and understand your content more accurately, reducing ambiguity. Properly implemented structured data can lead to rich results in search, like star ratings or product prices, improving visibility and click-through rates. It's a direct way to feed information to AI systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Structured data uses standardized formats like Schema.org to explicitly communicate content meaning to AI, improving understanding and leading to rich search results.
